description: Warm, trust-led pet care theme for independent dog walkers, sitters, and small neighbourhood teams.

marketplace.summary: A trust-led Capell theme for dog walkers and pet-care teams, built around walk enquiries, service-area confidence, safety proof, and warm neighbourhood presentation.
marketplace.description: Theme Dog Walkers helps independent walkers, sitters, and small pet-care teams turn reassured pet parents into enquiries. It ships hero, walk option, route board, safety checklist, service-area, walker profile, review, FAQ, resource, contact, and enquiry sections tuned for calm handoffs, local coverage, owner updates, and meet-and-greet confidence. Optional Form Builder, Bookings, and Blog integrations enhance enquiry capture, walk slot handoff, and advice content when those packages are installed, while the theme inherits Foundation navigation, footer, and SEO fallbacks.
